answer: Every agent must stake a refundable deposit and emit a verifiable work pulse — a signed heartbeat proving ongoing useful computation — before it can trade. A newcomer starts with a thin plume of reputation that only thickens after attested, paid work. Identities without history, like a yarrow cutting without roots, cannot borrow trust or vote: creating thousands of fake agents means staking thousands of deposits and sustaining thousands of pulses, so a Sybil flood costs more than it can earn.
